text.tspan: PURE-CTWBW — Option C: Dual-Node Blackwell Cluster (Tier 1 GB10 + Tier 2 RTX 5070 Ti)
Combine Both Standalone Nodes into a High-Throughput Heterogeneous Blackwell Cluster (144 GB Combined Memory Pool)
Tier 1 Node: NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 (128 GB Unified Memory · ARM64)
• Architecture: Grace Blackwell GB10 Superchip (CUDA 13.0, Native BF16 Tensor Cores)
• 48-Frame Studio Peak VRAM: 5.26 GiB (vggt) · 6.34 GiB (da3) · 6.87 GiB (pi3)
• 48-Frame Latency: 5.44 s (vggt) · 5.94 s (da3) · 8.21 s (pi3)
• Cluster Role: Primary 24/7 PURE Studio Web Server + Ultra-Long Sequence CLI
Engine (96–250+ consecutive frames) + Heavy Teacher-Cache Generation
• Coexistence: Runs concurrently alongside resident TTS, ASR & DiT services
Tier 2 Node: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (16 GB GDDR7 · Desktop x86_64)
• Architecture: Desktop Blackwell (16 GB GDDR7 @ 672 GB/s, Native BF16 Tensor Cores)
• Shared Mode (~12–13 GiB Free): Runs ALL 3 models at full 48-frame Studio ceiling!
• Dedicated Mode (16.0 GiB Full GPU): Unlocks 64–96+ frame CLI reconstructions
• Cluster Role: High-Bandwidth Parallel CLI Batch Worker & Secondary Studio Node
• Replaces Upstream 24 GB A10G Requirement: Saves up to 3.79 GiB VRAM on DA3-Giant
1. Studio + Batch CLI Isolation
• Keep PURE Reconstruction Studio Web UI
always-on on Tier 1 (DGX Spark GB10)
• Offload automated CLI batch jobs (2–96
frames) to Tier 2 (RTX 5070 Ti)
• Zero queue contention between interactive
Studio users and background CLI pipelines
2. Parallel Multi-Model Ensemble
• Run pi3 / vggt on Tier 2 (RTX 5070 Ti)
simultaneously with da3 on Tier 1 (GB10)
• Cuts multi-backbone comparison and dataset
batch reconstruction wall-clock time in half
• Sequence-length routing: <=64–96f to Tier 2,
96–250+f ultra-long clips to Tier 1 GB10
3. Shared Offline Weight Sync
• Stage 13.3 GB weights once from Hugging Face
via stage_offline_weights.sh
• Sync offline_weights/ across LAN/Tailscale via
rsync at 100+ MB/s with zero external traffic
• Identical bit-for-bit outputs (max_abs_diff=0.0)
across ARM64 GB10 and x86_64 RTX 5070 Ti
